Dimensional Rift

Times Square, New York. The rift over the city is spilling cursed spirits and rogue ninja. Spider-Man tossed you a Web-Shooter before he was pulled through. Every enemy you defeat surrenders its technique. Only five can be equipped, and the ones at range will shoot back.

The rift tore open more than one world. Gates ring every arena: Tokyo Jujutsu High, the Tombs of the Star Corridor, the Kyoto academy, a sealed Culling Game colony, and the Lands of Wind, Earth, Water and Lightning. Each has its own enemies and its own wave count.

It plays on a phone — landscape, with on-screen controls — and two people can share one rift: open this page on both devices and you will find each other. Co-op puts you in the same waves; Versus points you at each other.

On a phone: left thumb is the stick, drag anywhere on the right to look. HIT, JUMP, DODGE and WEB sit under your right thumb; the ability cards along the top are buttons — tap them. G is the ultimate, B charges output, and the gate button appears when you stand in a ring.

Fire beats Wind, Wind beats Lightning, Lightning beats Earth, Earth beats Water, Water beats Fire.
